solution.title: Google Workspace Security Baseline, DLP & Context-Aware Access (CAA)

products.name: Google Workspace Security Baseline, DLP & Context-Aware Access (CAA) — Commercial
products.short_description: Establish the Google Workspace security posture — admin hardening baseline, DLP for Drive/Gmail, and Context-Aware Access — so corporate data is protected under Zero-Trust, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Harden Google Workspace to enterprise standard from day one

A new Google Workspace tenant is not secure by default at enterprise standard. This solution establishes the Google Workspace security posture: an admin-console hardening baseline (2SV, session controls, sharing), Data Loss Prevention (DLP) rules for Drive/Gmail, and Context-Aware Access (CAA) that gates access on device and context — so corporate data is protected under Zero-Trust, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Workspace security model: hardening baseline, DLP, Context-Aware Access, and how they enforce Zero-Trust.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Workspace edition supporting DLP/CAA, super-admin, identity/context signals, a pilot OU) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to apply the named hardening baseline (2SV, sessions, sharing), build DLP rules for Drive/Gmail, and define CAA access levels + assignments, on a pilot then expand.
  • 5 supporting scripts — security-posture discovery, per-OU baseline/DLP/CAA validation, a posture coverage/exception report, safe remediation, and a scope helper.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (baseline applied, DLP blocks, CAA gates) plus Best Practices for staged enforcement.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A Google Workspace tenant hardened to enterprise standard — baseline, DLP, and Context-Aware Access enforcing Zero-Trust — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GWSEC-Discovery.ps1 — read-only Google Workspace security-posture discovery (baseline, DLP, CAA signals)
    • GWSEC-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation of scriptable posture findings (default -WhatIf)
    • GWSEC-Report.ps1 — read-only fleet posture coverage / exceptions report across organizational units
    • GWSEC-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create the security-baseline pilot OU (idempotent, default -WhatIf)
    • GWSEC-Validation.ps1 — read-only per-OU validation of baseline / DLP / CAA against the intended posture

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
